mkdir -p /tmp/analysis && cat > /tmp/analysis/count.py << 'EOF'
import re, glob, os, sys
from collections import Counter
base = sys.argv[1]
files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(base, "data/text/*.txt")))
pdfs = glob.glob(os.path.join(base, "data/originals/orders/*.pdf"))
print("txt files:", len(files), "pdf files:", len(pdfs))
cases = []
for f in files:
    txt = open(f, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()
    pages = re.split(r"=== page \d+", txt)
    for p in pages:
        if "finds the following" not in p.replace("\n"," ") and "violation" not in p:
            continue
        m = re.search(r"Case\s*Number:\s*(\S+)", p)
        if not m: continue
        cm = re.search(r"finds\s+the\s+following\s+violation\(?s?\)?:?\s*(.*?)(?:The Advisory|Advisory Committee recommends)", p, re.S)
        cite_block = cm.group(1) if cm else ""
        cites = re.findall(r"IC\s*8\s*-\s*1\s*-\s*26\s*-\s*([0-9A-Za-z()\-]+)", cite_block)
        cases.append((os.path.basename(f), m.group(1), cites))
print("cases found:", len(cases))
print("cases with 0 cites:", sum(1 for c in cases if not c[2]))
print("cases with >1 cite:", sum(1 for c in cases if len(c[2])>1))
def base_sec(c):
    c = re.sub(r"\((?:[A-Za-z]{2,}(?:-[A-Za-z]+)*)\)\s*$", "", c)
    return c
bs = Counter()
for fn, cn, cites in cases:
    for c in cites:
        bs[base_sec(c)] += 1
for k,v in bs.most_common(): print(repr(k), v)
n = len(cases)
c1 = sum(1 for fn,cn,cites in cases if any(base_sec(c)=="16(h)" for c in cites))
c2 = sum(1 for fn,cn,cites in cases if any(base_sec(c)=="20(a)(2)" for c in cites))
print("n", n, "16(h)", c1, round(100*c1/n,1), "20(a)(2)", c2, round(100*c2/n,1))
EOF
